title: Biofoundry
controls_hint: Drag the map or tap +/− to zoom; use the visible buttons for every required action
about: Build a living factory beneath the earth. Dig tunnels, feed your goblins, and keep a hungry colony supplied as it grows.

controls.desc: Drag the map to look around
Tap Pause to stop the simulation while keeping the Warren controls available

Tap buildings, tools, and tutorial actions where shown
